name: Umutwa
body:
UMUTWA
CR 1

You see a tiny fey creature, well-armed and with a bold expression.

XP 400
CN Fine fey
Init +5; Senses low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 23, flat-footed 18 (+5 Dex, +8 size)
hp 13 (3d6+3)
Fort +2, Ref +8, Will +3
DR 2/cold iron; SR 12

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee spear +5 (1d2-4/x3)
Ranged longbow +14 (1d3-4/x3)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks poison (black adder venom)

STATISTICS

Str 3, Dex 21, Con 12, Int 11, Wis 10, Cha 13
Base Atk +1; CMB -11; CMD 14
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot
Skills Acrobatics +10, Climb +9, Handle Animal +4, Knowledge (nature) +4, Perception +6, Ride +7, Stealth +23, Survival +4
Languages Common, Sylvan
Gear Fine spear, fine longbow, 10 arrows, black adder venom (1)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Black Adder Venom (Ex)

injury; save Fort DC 11, frequency 1/round for 6 rounds, effect 1d2 Con, cure 1 save

Poison Use (Ex)

An umutwa never risks poisoning themselves when applying poison to their weapons or attacking.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, war party (3-18)
Treasure incidental

Umutwa are tiny but feared and respected. Despite their size, they are capable hunters and doughty defenders of nature.

It is considered important to acknowledge, when meeting an umutwa, that you have seen it, as any implication that it was invisible or hard to see may be taken as insult toward its stature. Umutwa tame and ride horses and other animals.

They are very practical, said to use every scrap of an animal that has been hunted or slaughtered.

Umutwa use tiny weapons but attack fiercely. Their knowledge of poisons is equal to or greater than that of large folk, making their tiny arrows and spears particularly dangerous.

Umutwa react fiercely to insults. They are also proud of their accomplishments and susceptible to flattery. Umutwa are protective of their lands, natural creatures, and their neighbors, but deadly and aggressive toward intruders.
